assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Eleven independent conditional occurrences (seven Intimacy addresses, one Short message, one Birthday portfolio and two multi-chapter Event families) with no inferred unlock level, calendar year or total chronology across them; each reading forbids treating menu, catalog or execution order as progression, and B0246 and B0249 state that their Event families have no exact year or placement relative to Main or the other families. B0246's chapter order (commission, outings, houseboat proposal, retrospective party report) and B0249's chapter order (walk, riverside, commercial street, office and park) hold only inside each occurrence; B0249's New Year sale, New Year live and snowy-mountain filming trip are local, attributed or recalled references and are not dated against each other. dimensions.note: One pattern recurs across five independently gated readings: older-sister competence is a way of addressing someone, held together with wanting and fallibility. B0189 finds this its strongest common finding: developing driving (B:P3), a request to receive care (E:P2-P4), deliberation beside a continuing idol intention (D:P3) and dissatisfaction turned into a practice proposal (G:P2-P4). B0232 case 05 has the older-sister self-address used playfully while she offers to connect a friend (P0-P2). B0237 404000026 shows her receiving a remembered wish, admitting a practical difficulty (P12-P13) and keeping a qualified future wish (P14-P18). B0246 Family3 tests the pattern among peers: an older-sister offer of companionship and an apology for a digression (504016201 P10-35; CL-B0246-081), a questionably easy appeal to Player's resources (504016203 P1-9; CL-B0246-100) and proposal credit beside confirmed early intoxication (504016205 P1-12; CL-B0246-115). B0249 Family 3 tests it again across four chapters: she admits that buying ski wear for both companions may have overreached and that their own choice matters (506019601 P34-38; CL-B0249-030, -032), offers to accompany and catch Saori (506019602 P27-31; CL-B0249-036), gives flirtation advice and then questions it when Tomoe escalates (506019603 P27-38; CL-B0249-045, -048), and worries about the park plan before qualifying her worry (506019604 P16-26; CL-B0249-055). The readings reject an infallible caretaker in both families. D rather than E because the support is distributed and rival-tested in two multi-speaker occurrences. Not C because no conditional rule or state guard is derived: the readings describe a particular, corrigible practice, not when it switches on or off.

The readings forbid ordering the eleven occurrences. B0237's driving wish is related to B0189 B's developing-driving report only thematically, and explicitly does not upgrade it into demonstrated skill. B0246 and B0249 each track a sequence within one family but give it no year or placement, and B0249's felt closeness (506019604 P6-15) is a change inside that family only (CL-B0249-049). Earlier Mimi states are context only and not enrolled.

Located register evidence is local: the address 支配人君 and the self-address ミミお姉さん (B0189, B0232 P0), written kaomoji (B0232), a teasing warning (B0232 P2), and in B0237 the でも that keeps her anticipation after the joke (P17-18). B0246 adds her official-uniform formulation (504016202 P15-24; CL-B0246-090), reported in paraphrase. B0249 adds the older-sister self-address again (506019601 P38-40) and her address of Tomoe as an older sister (506019602 P32), but otherwise paraphrases her lines, and its written ellipses are authored text, not a disclosed tone. All voice cues are unheard, one B0249 Mimi cue is unresolved (506019604 P27), and B0232 carries no voice.

Ordinary activities in the address readings are reported or proposed: a holiday drive, an all-day job, a forehead fever check described afterwards, a photo-practice proposal (B0189), and shopping for clothes with a university friend (B0232); B0237 adds one received party. B0246 enacts a planning outing through Old-EDO Street, a restaurant complex and a dusk riverside (504016202-504016204), with the party itself retrospective (504016205). B0249 enacts a second outing, a walk with Tomoe and Saori through a shopping street, a riverside embankment and a commercial street, in which she asks where they want to go, proposes a reasonably priced shop she likes and imagines outfits for Tomoe (506019601 P0-7, 506019603 P0-7). It also gives her own account of a shopping practice: cheap goods that were previously unaffordable excite her, inferior goods need discernment, rival shoppers need speed and winning is satisfying (506019601 P23-33; CL-B0249-031). D rather than E because everyday conduct is now distributed across two enacted outings and a self-described practice, each rival-tested. Not C because both outings are task-occasioned (a commission and a magazine request), the shopping practice is self-description rather than observed procedure (the bargain purchase is recalled, not staged), and no proposed clothes outing or bargain retry is shown.

Three readings give a silent addressee, the manager (支配人君), whose replies come only through her uptake, plus collective thanks and a group-drive idea in B0237. B0246 Family3 adds speaking peers and managers, with conduct that differs by counterpart: reassurance, teasing and questions to Kazumi; praise and credit to Miu; resignation and later complaint about Coney; an assumption of payment and apology toward Player (504016201-504016205). B0249 Family 3 adds a second complete occurrence with different counterparts: to Tomoe she offers outfit possibilities, flirtation advice and an older-sister address (506019603 P0-26, 506019602 P32), and does not receive Tomoe's private motive (CL-B0249-038); to Saori she offers accompaniment and shared catching, accepts Saori's warning and asks to learn Yamaism from her (506019602 P27-31, P39-43; CL-B0249-036, -039); to Player she gives thanks he deflects and withholds the interview account (506019604 P6-15; CL-B0249-050). D rather than E because recipient differences are located across five readings with real other-speaker turns in two occurrences. Not C because no recipient-conditioned rule is derived, and the readings keep each counterpart's reception distinct rather than modeling what she would do with a new one. This matches the Murasaki call (two multi-speaker occurrences, D).

Interior states are spoken self-reports: wanting to depend on someone sometimes (B0189 E:P2), having been prompted to think about the future (B0189 D), the enjoyment of choosing clothes (B0232 P1), joy at a gathered party at any age (B0237 P0-P9), a worry that the Nanasta venue would lack impact (B0246 504016204 P11-16), and in B0249 feeling closer to both companions after much enjoyable remembering (506019604 P6-15). Her imagined date scene is authored hypothesis (CL-B0246-097). B0249's solitary codas after her companions leave (506019603 P33-38, 506019604 P49-52) are spoken appraisals heard only by the reader, and the reading says her ellipses do not disclose a precise inner state (CL-B0249-048, -055). In B0249 the parenthesized private thought belongs to Tomoe, not Mimi. No inward narration of Mimi is distinguished from speech.

Only B0246 and B0249 analyze friction involving Mimi, and it is brief. In B0246, Kazumi questions her sports-day idea and later rejects reintroduced table tennis, and Mimi switches proposals or calls it a joke (504016201 P26-35, 504016204 P11-16; CL-B0246-080, -110); she criticizes Coney for approving without reading much, and Coney rebuts (504016205 P1-7; CL-B0246-114); she apologizes when teased about early drunkenness (P8-12). In B0249, Saori resists her accompaniment offer and warns how often she falls (506019602 P27-31; CL-B0249-036, -037), and Mimi objects to Tomoe's swimsuit-and-hut plan as suspicious in the city (506019603 P27-32; CL-B0249-045). Each is settled, deflected or left open locally. Not D because no sustained dispute or escalation is analyzed. The address readings' teasing rebukes (B0189 A, B; B0232 P2; B0237 P17) are read as play, not disputes.

Only B0249 supplies located normative self-revision by Mimi: she says buying ski wear for both companions may have overreached and that they should perhaps choose such things themselves, though she meant well (506019601 P34-38; CL-B0249-030, -058), and after Tomoe leaves she asks herself whether she encouraged too much before judging more assertiveness better for Tomoe (506019603 P33-38; CL-B0249-045, -048). E because these are two short, local reflections on respecting another person's choice and on the scale of her own influence. Not D because the readings do not frame either as sustained ethical reasoning, she applies no stated principle, and Saori's Yamaism, the family's explicit responsibility principle, is Saori's, not hers (CL-B0249-034, -035). B0189 D's future deliberation concerns a career choice and is not ethical deliberation.

A teasing qualification of a wish recurs across the address readings, each with its rivals tested: the misunderstanding warning that ends in a wish (B0189 A), the permanent-employment joke (B0189 D), the forehead tease (B0189 F) and the posing instruction (B0189 G); the warning not to get strange ideas (B0232 P2); and the next-birthday request called a joke and then still anticipated (B0237 P16-18). B0246 shows play among peers: the official-uniform formulation, table tennis retracted as a joke, and teasing Kazumi (504016202-504016205). B0249 adds her rejection of Tomoe's awakening metaphor as exaggeration (506019601 P23-33; CL-B0249-032) and the playful flirtation script she proposes for Tomoe (506019603 P15-26; CL-B0249-044), which she then reins in. D because the mode is distributed and discriminated. Not C because what triggers the qualification, and how a recipient would receive it, is not modeled.

Each curated unit is complete with exact native review: B0189's seven occurrences, B0232's three-page message, B0237's 20-page Birthday portfolio, B0246's complete 186-page five-chapter Event family and B0249's complete 179-page four-chapter Event family, in both of which she speaks in every chapter. The earlier Main and Sub readings are not enrolled, B0246's party is reported only in retrospect, one B0249 Mimi cue is unresolved (506019604 P27), and no performed audio, loop movie or runtime was reviewed. Not D because the subject's Main and Sub arc is outside the curated set.

Affirmative local limits are located: her driving is still developing (B0189 B:P3), she is dissatisfied with recent photos (B0189 G), she states that driving at the represented place would be difficult and begins to mention an international licence (B0237 P13), and she says she wants to receive care as well as give it (B0189 E:P2). B0246 adds her apology for the planning digression, Miu's doubt of her assumption that Player will pay, and reported early drunkenness as host (504016201-504016205). B0249 adds her admitted overreach in choosing clothes for others (506019601 P34-38), Saori's warning that her catching offer underestimates the falls (506019602 P27-31; CL-B0249-036), her startled objection once her advice is escalated and her self-questioning about it (506019603 P27-38; CL-B0249-045), and an untested forecast that men receive bargain talk poorly (506019601 P41; CL-B0249-033). Each limit is case-local, so D is not supported.

The readings establish that no chronology, calendar or unlock level orders the occurrences. Local markers are only relative: today's all-day job (B0189 C), since this morning (B0189 D), next year's birthday (B0237 P16), an autumn frame with a dusk progression inside B0246's outing (504016204 P1-10), and B0249's New Year sale and New Year live, which the reading keeps without exact date or Main placement and does not date against the recalled filming trip (506019601 P23-33, 506019604 P0-5).

scenario_readiness.note: Her Japanese is mostly paraphrased, with a few addresses, kaomoji and short quoted words; all voice cues are unheard and one B0249 cue is unresolved. B0246 and B0249 supply multi-speaker structure but little quoted wording. Generated lines would be fluent invention rather than source-supported voice. This bounds the evidence set, not Mimi's speech.

scenario_readiness.note: Eleven unordered occurrences, nine of them short addresses to one silent interlocutor or a collective audience and two task-occasioned multi-chapter families, with no conditional rules, cannot support a novel context.

Two enacted outings, a self-described shopping practice, proposed outings, a reported shopping trip and one received party answer bounded canon questions about these occurrences. They give no procedure for an unfamiliar ordinary situation: both outings are occasioned by work, and her proposed clothes outing and bargain retry are never shown.

Two short B0249 self-revisions, about choosing clothes for others and about over-encouraging Tomoe (506019601 P34-38, 506019603 P33-38), are the only normative reflection in evidence. They cannot support simulating ethical deliberation in another situation.

B0189 finds her affection explicit but directional, with no matching answer from the manager. B0232's warning proves neither jealousy nor an exclusive claim. B0237 keeps a group drive beside the earlier wish for two-person conversation without an exclusivity rule. B0246's date scene is an explicitly framed hypothetical (CL-B0246-097, -120). In B0249 her flirtation advice concerns Tomoe's appeal, not her own, her generalizations about boys are her appraisal, and her maiden-hearts coda interprets Tomoe and Saori (506019603 P15-26, 506019604 P49-52; CL-B0249-044, -054); she keeps the interview account from Player as maiden-heart material without disclosing it (506019604 P11-15). The evidence cannot support simulating a romance.

B0189 has her look forward to an all-day job (C) and propose photo practice (G), and B0237 nests a drive inside hypothetical overseas work. B0246 shows a commissioned planning task in progress whose party and approval are only reported (CL-B0246-113-115). B0249 adds a magazine request for filming-trip anecdotes, her concern that bargain talk will be poorly received, and an interview account she withholds from Player; no interview, publication or editorial choice is shown, and the well-received New Year live is Player's report (506019601 P16-22, P41; 506019604 P0-15; CL-B0249-029, -050). No idol work is performed in any reading, so a professional scenario would be invention.

known_limits.statement: The eleven sources are independent conditional occurrences with no total chronology, year or unlock level; menu, catalog or execution order cannot make any occurrence a progression, the chapter orders of B0246 and B0249 hold only inside each family, and cross-case comparisons are thematic.

The drive, the workday, the fever check, the photo practice, the shopping trip and the friend introduction are reported or proposed. None is enacted, and the manager's answers come only through her uptake.
B0189 B reports her driving as still developing, and B0237 states a practical difficulty and an international-licence concern. No licence, trip or driving performance is established.

The next-birthday group-drive wish is nested inside hypothetical overseas work, called a joke and still anticipated. It is neither a binding request nor an absent desire, and no manager assent is supplied.
The university friend's preference, consent and reaction, and the photographer's view, are absent. They enter only through Mimi's appraisal.

No performed voice, laughter, music, SFX, loop movie or continuous runtime was heard or watched; B0246 leaves a closing cue unresolved and B0249 leaves one Mimi cue unresolved (506019604 P27). Fixed portraits, stand art and ordinary-outfit sprites are not performances; no yukata, meal, houseboat, ski purchase, clothes fitting or catch is pictured.

Her restaurant-date scene in B0246 504016203 is an explicitly framed hypothetical with an unidentified companion and a star-field background. It supplies no actual date, partner, Player promise or remembered occasion.

The appreciation party, its houseboat venue, the approval of her written proposal and her early drunkenness are reported only in retrospect in B0246 504016205. No booking, boarding, hosting conduct or the specific teased behavior is shown, and Player's account of the drinking's effect is his appraisal.
Her assumption that Player will cover restaurant costs is questioned by Miu and receives no manager response; it establishes neither his assent nor a budget.

In B0249 the bargain ski-wear purchase, Saori's trampling and infirmary visit, the snowy-mountain filming trip and the earlier Player collision are attributed recollections, not staged scenes. The payer, gift status, prior selection consent, injury severity and medical outcome are not supplied, and the park mishap's physical result is unestablished.

Her proposed shared clothes outing, her offer to accompany and catch Saori, and her forecast that Player would catch Saori are never implemented or confirmed in B0249; Saori warns that the offer underestimates her falls, and Player gives no promise.

Her expectation that men receive bargain talk poorly and her generalization about boys' susceptibility to a flirtatious appeal are her own forecasts. B0249 supplies no audience, editor or Player confirmation, and Player answers Tomoe's attempt with a tissue, not the forecast response.
The interview story she settles on is withheld from Player and never disclosed in B0249; it is neither shown to be unchosen nor published.
The earlier Mimi readings (B0086, B0124, B0162, B0170) are not curated on this subject, so the readings' comparisons with them were not checked. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
Apart from addresses, kaomoji and short quoted words, the readings paraphrase Mimi's Japanese, so self-reference and sentence endings are largely absent from the curated evidence.

dimensions.note: The reading's cumulative finding is that older-sister competence is a way of addressing someone, not an inventory of capacities: she offers care and company while admitting developing driving (B:P3), keeping idol intention beside deliberation about the future (D:P3), asking to receive care (E:P2-P4) and proposing self-directed photo practice (G:P2-P4). The pattern is coherent across seven short addresses but derives no conditional rule, so D is not supported.

The occurrences are unordered, and the reading states that they do not establish their position relative to the earlier Mimi chapters, which are not enrolled. No change is tracked beyond a few pages within an address.

Located speech acts include her older-sister self-address, the address 支配人君, the temporary possessive my manager (C:P3-P4), the permanent-employment joke (D:P4-P5) and the instruction not to be embarrassed (G). The reading paraphrases rather than quoting her Japanese, and the 29 voice cues were not heard.

Ordinary conduct is mostly proposed: a holiday drive with her as driver, a photo-practice session and future nursing. An all-day job and the forehead fever check (F:P1-P3) are given through her own account. No completed outing or routine is shown.

Mimi is the sole authored speaker and addresses only the manager, whose expressions and replies come through her uptake. The friend and the photographer are unnamed reported roles. The reading calls the relation directional; one relation does not support recipient conditioning.

Interior states are spoken: seeming troubled since morning and thinking about her future (D:P1-P3), sometimes wanting to depend on someone (E:P2) and dissatisfaction with her photos (G). No inward narration is distinguished from speech.

Calling the manager insensitive (A) and rebuking his worried face (B) are read as teasing and caution, not conflict. No interpersonal conflict is analyzed; absence here is not evidence that she avoids it.
The reading's consent and entitlement caveats concern what the source does not authorize, not Mimi's ethical reasoning. Nothing is established about her ethical deliberation.

Flirtatious play is located in four addresses and read as coexisting with care: the misunderstanding warning (A), the permanent-employment joke (D:P4-P5), the joke that the forehead check raised his temperature (F:P3) and the sexy-poses proposal (G:P3-P4). A short repertoire inside one relation, not a model of when she plays.

The family is complete: seven occurrences, all 36 native page objects and 29 Japanese records read, native/normalized equality passed, one composite and four backgrounds viewed. It is still seven short addresses; earlier Mimi readings are not enrolled, and no performed audio or runtime was reviewed.

Affirmative limits are located: she admits her driving is still developing and narrows her reassurance (B:P3), and she is dissatisfied with her recent photo session (G). The reading also rules out a license, safety assessment, clinical diagnosis or improved images from the source.
The reading establishes that menu priority supplies no intimacy level, native order no chronology and voice filenames no dating. Only within-address order is fixed.
